intendedChanges.summary: Reduce the unsecured cash recovery from fifty-five to forty percent; Supporting Creditor can counter with a supplemental distribution from proceeds above the plan forecast.
Accelerate confirmation from 120 days to 75 days; Debtor can counter with an extension for tribunal scheduling delays outside its control.
Increase the financing principal that Supporting Creditor agrees not to oppose from $1.5 million to $2.5 million, increasing potential priority exposure subject to approval.
Reduce the approved adviser-expense reimbursement ceiling from $50,000 to $20,000.

Extend the mutual breach cure period from five to fifteen business days; the creditor loses speed in exiting for Debtor breach and can counter with five days for a failure to deliver required cash forecasts.
Move the unchanged confidentiality clause from Section 5 to Section 10, before the notices paragraph. Keeping a following paragraph lets the comparison engine pair the clause as one move.
Replace constitute with form in the electronic-counterparts sentence without changing its effect.
Replace state with explain in the invoice-dispute sentence as a neutral wording clean-up.
